title: Blow By Pressure High Error
detail_of_failure: The pressure sensed by the blowby pressure sensor is 1.96 kPa or above.
machine_effect: If the machine is used as it is, the engine can be damaged.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If failure code [DHE5MA] is also shown, do the troubleshooting for this code first. Monitoring code The blowby pressure can be monitored. (Code: 42803)

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. For details, see RELATED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT, CHECKS BEFORE TROU- BLESHOOTING, Electrical equipment. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Check if the block on which the blowby pressure sensor is installed, tube and squeezed part of tip are clogged. 2. Are the block on which the blowby pressure sensor is installed, tube and squeezed part of tip normal?

branches.YES: • The blowby pressure sensor is normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • The blowby pressure sensor is abnormal. • Replace the blowby pressure sensor. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Insert the T-adapter into connector CP01. 3. Start the engine. Turn the starting switch to the ON position. 4. Measure the voltage. 5. Does the troubleshooting result agree with the standard value? Stand- Measuring point and measurement Item ard valcondition ue Between CP01 (female) (55) and 0.3 to Voltage (18) 3.6V

branches.YES: • The pump controller is normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • The pump controller is defective. • Replace the pump controller. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Do the inspection above again. 2. Can you identify the cause by reconfirmation?

branches.NO: • The engine controller can be defective. • Replace the engine. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Turn the starting switch to the OFF position. 2. Connect all the configuration equipment. 3. Turn the starting switch to the ON position to troubleshoot. 4. Is this failure code shown?

branches.YES: Return to the first inspection item.
